text:
lin: Noticing a recurring hole in span ingestion across nightly ETL windows. Three separate jobs showed a sudden drop in span counts ~02:00 UTC. This matches a pattern from last month's postmortem but with different symptoms.
ops-bot: Created INC-2026-143 (P2) Observability: intermittent span ingestion drops. Details: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-143
sam: any quick hypothesis? ETL backpressure or a transform bug?
maya: early signal points to the aggregator's dedupe/join stage dropping rows when trace_id is malformed. Example failure from the job log: `agg_worker: warn dropped=87 reason=trace_id_invalid`
jess: I can pick up the aggregator defensiveness. Plan: 1) tighten input validation, 2) mark bad rows for quarantine instead of dropping, 3) add unit test for malformed trace_id. ETA: 72h for patch.
kevin: I'll add a short-term metric to capture "dropped_by_reason" and a dashboard tile. Also propose an alert: dropped_count > 50 in a 10m window. ETA: 24h.
sam: For backfill we need an estimate of quarantined rows. I'll run a dry-run scanner to count affected rows and post results. Target to run real backfill next Wednesday during low-traffic window.
lin: Do we know if this impacts customer spans or only internal telemetry?
maya: initial crawl indicates mostly internal observability traces, but a small subset touches customer-facing services (non-critical). No outage.
jess: Action items (draft):
- jess Aggregator hardening + quarantine path + tests (ETA 3d)
- sam Dry-run row count + backfill runbook (ETA 2d for counts, backfill next Wed)
- kevin Metric + dashboard + alert rule (ETA 24h)
- lin Coordinate canary backfill and runbook approval (ETA 5d)
- maya Update postmortem with new repro steps & attach logs (ETA 48h)
kevin: I'll open the remediation board cards and link to the incident doc.
sam: Dry-run posted: https://storage.internal/observability/dryrun-199999.csv - ~12k rows flagged across last 7 days, concentrated in two services.
jess: Good data. I'll ensure quarantine schema preserves raw payload for replay/backfill.
lin: Recommend weekly check-ins for 3 weeks post-fix to watch recurrence and SLO drift.
maya: Agree. Tentative sync: Mon 10am PT. I'll also add a small regression test to the nightly suite to catch this class of issue.
kevin: :thumbsup:
sam: acked. I'll block the backfill window and share maintenance notes.
ops-bot: INC-2026-143 status updated: triage complete, owners assigned.
jess: I'll post a PR with the fix branch for early review later today.
lin: Thanks all let's keep this tight, we don't want recurrence.
jess: :rocket:
